title: Anthropic · Forward Deployed Engineer
subtitle: Progressive coding, Claude deployment design, customer discovery, values

stages.title: Recruiter & hiring-manager screen
stages.tests: Motivation (why Anthropic, why FDE), which Claude models you've used and what you built, then a hiring-manager deep dive on one project: ownership, tradeoffs, what broke.
stages.methodology: 60–90 s pitch: customer-facing engineer → built a production Claude platform solo → wants to do that for strategic customers. Deep dive as STAR + architecture: problem → constraints → decisions/tradeoffs → what broke → metrics → what you'd change.

stages.title: Coding (progressive levels)
stages.tests: Practical Python, one problem extended level by level (in-memory DB, bank, LRU cache, rate limiter, crawler). Clean, extensible code under time pressure; syntax lookup allowed, no AI.
stages.methodology: Clarify → examples as asserts → plan for extension (small class, dict state) → code the simplest correct version while narrating → test edge cases → refactor before each new level, keep old tests green.

stages.title: Claude deployment & system design
stages.tests: Architecting a Claude deployment for an enterprise customer: MCP tool surface and trust boundaries, hosted vs self-hosted, RAG, evals, failure modes.
stages.methodology: Requirements → architecture (RAG, orchestration, MCP tools, model choice, batch vs real-time) → data flow & trust boundaries → failure modes (hallucination, prompt injection, rate limits, cost) → evals → human checkpoints → observability/audit → phased rollout.

stages.title: Customer role-play
stages.tests: Live discovery with a non-technical executive or skeptical architect, no editor. Business constraints, data boundaries, past AI failures; resist designing too early.
stages.methodology: Agenda → business goal & success metric → current state (workflow, systems, data owners, volume) → constraints (privacy, residency, security review, budget) → history of past attempts → stakeholders & risks → play back → propose a narrow pilot with an eval set → next steps.

stages.title: Behavioral & values
stages.tests: Mission alignment, AI-risk reasoning and honesty; reportedly weighted like the technical rounds. Specific, honest views beat 'performing alignment'.
stages.methodology: STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) + honest reflection. Know the RSP (v3.x) and Core Views well enough to agree and disagree with specifics.
